cases.title: Complex: «z = r(cos30° + i sin30°)» stays on the 30° ray at every press
cases.lookFor: z stays in quadrant I on the 30° ray at every press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת»; it never jumps to 210°. The parameters row reads «r — חופשי». (The canvas label shows the sampled decimal, e.g. «z ≈ 0.65+0.37i», as before; that is the open #1738.)
cases.before: Every other press flipped z to 210°, with «z ≈ |r|·cis210°».

cases.title: Complex: a stated modulus gives r = 5
cases.lookFor: z = 5√3/2+(5/2)i (that is 5·cis30°) and the parameters read «r = 5», not ±5. «הציגו תצורה אחרת» is greyed out: there is only one configuration.

cases.title: Complex refusal: «r = -3» after «z = r cis 30»
cases.lookFor: The second line is not added; the strip reads «המשפט לא נוסף — אינו מתיישב עם: "z = r cis 30"».
cases.before: Accepted, with z drawn green at 3·cis210°.

cases.title: Complex refusal: «z ברביע השלישי» after «z = r cis 30»
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with the same message.

cases.title: Complex: «z = r cis 90» stays on the positive imaginary axis
cases.lookFor: z is on the positive imaginary axis at every press.
cases.before: It alternated between the positive and negative imaginary axis.

cases.title: Complex guard: «z = r·i» is unchanged
cases.lookFor: Still alternates between the positive and negative imaginary axis, as before (your ruling: both forms build, r·i as today).

cases.title: Complex: «z^3 = r cis 60» draws only the r > 0 roots
cases.lookFor: Three roots at 20°, 140° and 260°, unchanged on «הציגו תצורה אחרת» (the same as «z^3 = 8 cis 60»).

cases.title: 3-D refusal: a sphere of radius 1/2 is refused, not drawn as 1
cases.lookFor: No sphere is added; the message reads «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לקבוע את גודל הכדור לפי נתון כזה, ולכן הוא לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי».

cases.title: 3-D refusal: a cone of height 7/2
cases.lookFor: No cone is added; the same message, naming «החרוט».

cases.title: 3-D refusal: a cone of radius √2 gets the not-yet message
cases.lookFor: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לקבוע את גודל החרוט לפי נתון כזה…».
cases.before: «המשפט לא נוסף לציור, כי לא הצלחנו לצייר: √2. נסו לפצל…» (round #2053 T44).

cases.title: 3-D guard: a whole-number cone still builds
cases.lookFor: A cone appears, green, with radius 2 and height 3.

cases.title: 3-D guard: a decimal radius still builds
cases.lookFor: A cone appears, green, with radius 2.5.

cases.title: 3-D guard: a sphere with a whole radius still builds
